scope: What a lawn needs watered, and what becomes of it without water, for the home lawn in src/engine/systems/lawns.ts (row 43m), and what Fixr's home theater price includes, for the theater's screen and seats (row 43i). Status: verified = read on the publisher's own page on 2026-10-06; secondhand = seen only in a search-engine summary.

inchAWeek.claim: 'To keep lawns green throughout the growing season, they should receive approximately 1 inch of water each week, either from rainfall, irrigation, or a combination of both.'
inchAWeek.source: University of Wisconsin-Madison Extension, Lawn Maintenance

stmaAcreInch.claim: A natural grass athletic field is watered 1 acre-inch a week (a soccer field for 26 weeks); 33 mowings a season on native-soil practice fields and a sand-capped stadium field, 50 on a sand-based soccer field. Already recorded in research-special-rooms-outdoor.json (naturalGrass.fieldMaintenance).
stmaAcreInch.source: Sports Turf Managers Association, Natural Grass Athletic Fields bulletin

litersPerSquareMeter.derivation: An inch is 25.4 mm; a millimeter of water over a square meter is a liter.

withoutWater.claim: 'The leaves will stop growing and turn brown during extended periods of drought but dormant plants can remain alive for 2-3 months.'
withoutWater.source: University of Wisconsin-Madison Extension, Lawn Maintenance

daysToBrown.claim: 'Kentucky bluegrass can start turning brown after about 7 days without water.'
daysToBrown.source: University of Minnesota Extension, Conserving water on drought-affected lawns

recovery.claim: 'New leaves will grow once sufficient water is supplied for an extended period of time (10 days and longer).'
recovery.source: University of Wisconsin-Madison Extension, Lawn Maintenance

homeTheaterKit.claim: 'Most people spend $25,000 to install a fixed frame screen LED projector with 7.1 speakers and amplifier, professional wiring, and furniture.' Furniture is listed as an add-on of $500 to $20,000, with no count of seats. Page updated January 31, 2025.
homeTheaterKit.note: The same $25,000 is the average SLATE prices a home theater at (Angi's, through a search summary, research-facilities.json). Angi's own page returned 403. The four seats are research-special-rooms-indoor.json's spare-bedroom estimate (Seatcraft's commonest layout).

notFound: Rainfall depth by day: SLATE's weather keeps whether it rained, not how much, so a day of rain is taken for the week's inch.
A wattage for a home theater's projector: not looked for in this pass; the projector's electricity is not billed.
